                      "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 To ask where someone is from, say vous venez d\u0027où, or d\u0027où venez-vous.                       "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 Un is for masculine nouns, like un téléphone, un livre, un sac.                       "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 To buy something, say je voudrais, then the item.                       "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 Vingt is twenty, trente thirty, quarante forty, cinquante fifty, soixante sixty.                       "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 Le pain is bread, le fromage cheese, le riz rice, la viande meat, le poisson fish, les légumes vegetables.                       "expectedText":  null,

                      "imageUrl":  null,
                      "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 Reflexive verbs use me, te, se, nous, vous, se before the verb: je me lève, tu te laves, il se couche.                       "imageUrl":  null,
                      "content":  "\u003cp style=\"font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.6;\"\u003e🧑‍🏫 Infinitive + endings: je parlerai, tu parleras, il parlera, nous parlerons, vous parlerez, ils parleront. Irregulars: être (je serai), avoir (j\u0027aurai), aller (j\u0027irai), faire (je ferai).\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul style=\"list-style:none;padding:0;margin:10px 0 0;\"\u003e\u003cli style=\"padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);\"\u003e\u003cb\u003eDemain, il fera beau.\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan style=\"opacity:.7;\"\u003e · Tomorrow the weather will be nice.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli style=\"padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);\"\u003e\u003cb\u003eJe serai à la maison.\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan style=\"opacity:.7;\"\u003e · I will be at home.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli style=\"padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);\"\u003e\u003cb\u003eJ\u0027irai en France.\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan style=\"opacity:.7;\"\u003e · I will go to France.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli style=\"padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);\"\u003e\u003cb\u003eNous parlerons plus tard.\u003c/b\u003e\u003cspan style=\"opacity:.7;\"\u003e · We will talk later.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e",
                      "recordPrompt":  null,
